deadline.value: Apply by 1 January 2027 for September 2027 entry (same date for international applicants).
deadline.quote: September 2027 | International Applicants | Application Deadline1 January 2027

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

supervisor.value: No commitment is needed before applying, but you must contact potential supervisors first; many will not take students they have not heard from.
supervisor.quote: Clarification: no commitment from a supervisor prior to applying is necessary but you must contact your potential supervisor(s) before applying as many faculty won't accept students who they have not previously been in contact with.

funding.value: Every full-time PhD student gets at least CAD 40,000 a year for the first four years, from TAs, awards or the supervisor's grants.
funding.quote: Minimum funding per year* | *All full-time UBC PhD students receive, at a minimum, this amount of funding in each of the first four years. | The Department of Zoology has a minimum funding policy for all Graduate students.

entry_route.value: Normally admitted after an MSc; exceptional students can enter straight from a bachelor's.
entry_route.quote: Students admitted to the Ph.D. degree program normally possess an M.Sc. degree in Zoology or a related area, with clear evidence of research ability or potential. | Exceptional students may be admitted directly to the Ph.D. program from the bachelor's level.

gre_general.quote: The requirements for this program are: | The GRE is not required.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 90 overall (old 120-point scale) or 4.5 on the new 6-point scale; section minimums apply.
toefl_min.quote: 120-point scale for tests taken prior to Jan 21, 2026 | Overall score requirement: 90

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall, with section minimums.
ielts_min.quote: IELTS: International English Language Testing System (Academic) | Overall score requirement: 6.5

notes: Botany is a separate PhD (deadline 10 January 2027).
name: PhD in Zoology
